The front (−z) is the south portico facing the Rue Royale.
Footprint: 43.2 m along x by 128.3 m along z, centred on the origin.

[[-21.6,64.2],[-21.6,-64.2],[21.6,-64.2],[21.6,64.2]]

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter: full peripteral Corinthian colonnade with pediment, daylight
  2. long-side three-quarter along the colonnade with the front pediment at left, daylight
  3. elevated view over the rooftops of the pedimented front and the green-copper pitched roof (low resolution, processed look)

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: La Madeleine is a Roman peripteral temple on a tall podium. It has 8 Corinthian columns across the front and back and 18 per side (counting the corners twice), all standing free around a cella wall. A pediment with sculpture sits over each end, and a long gable roof of green-grey copper runs front to back. I model the podium, the cella, colonnades on all four sides, the two pediments and the gable roof. Column height is about 20 m on a 7 m podium, with the roof ridge reaching 36 m.
